title: A synced invoice is not sent again when its category is deleted
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Use staging with the QuickBooks sandbox connected, and sign in to that QuickBooks sandbox in a second browser window.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, mapped to a QuickBooks item for this test, item A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, made after customer B's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1), with a part in category A, invoiced and synced to QuickBooks.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A.
  3. Open the page's three-dot menu.
  4. Click Delete.
  5. Click Delete in the question.
  6. Open the invoice in the QuickBooks sandbox.
  7. Open work order 1.
  8. Sync the invoice to QuickBooks again from its Finance tab.
  9. Open the invoice in the QuickBooks sandbox again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories page lists category A.

Step 2:

  • Category A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The menu shows Audit Log and Delete.

Step 4:

  • The Delete question opens.

Step 5:

  • Category A is deleted.

Step 6:

  • The QuickBooks invoice still shows item A and its last change date is before the delete.

Step 7:

  • Work order 1's part now shows Uncategorized.

Step 8:

  • The invoice syncs again.

Step 9:

  • The QuickBooks line now uses Uncategorized's item.
